what_it_does: This work proposes hbcLock, a security system for wearable medical devices that encrypts sensitive health data before sending it wirelessly over standard protocols like Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) or Wi-Fi. The innovation is that the encryption key is transmitted through the wearer's body tissue rather than over the radio link, so only a device in physical contact with the person can decrypt the data. This combines RF (radio frequency) encryption with a secure biological channel.
